name: sudus
description: The referee for agent-led software development: reads the repository, names the next action.

view.title: Where the Sudus verdict shows
view.description: "status-line" (default): the verdict above the prompt with the face at its right. "pane": a pane beside the transcript with the face. "both". "off": nothing. Needs function hooks (early access).

face.title: Blobatar face
face.description: The text the face is drawn from; blobatar draws the same face from the same text every time, here, with no network.

motion.title: Face motion
motion.description: The face breathes, glances and blinks as blobatar does; false keeps it still. A terminal that shows no pictures gets the face in braille, which blinks.

command.title: sudus command
command.description: The command the mod runs for the verdict; "sudus" on PATH by default, and this plugin's own copy when that cannot start.
